item.title: Welcome to the TickerTruth Blog
item.description: TickerTruth started from a narrow, specific frustration: backtests on Indian equities that quietly fall apart because a ticker was reused, a symbol was renamed without anyone updating the mapping, or a bonus issue was applied on the wrong date. None of these show up as errors — they show up as wrong numbers that look plausible, which is the worst kind of bug in a trading system.
